subject: Console: per-slice sampling toggle + cost attribution probe
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T09:13:00-07:00
Subject: [Console] Probe: per-slice sampling toggle + cost attribution

Hi team,

We had a customer (Acme Analytics) flag a recurring mismatch between the per-route cost tile and the tenant billing. The sample rate on the slice seems to be lower than expected during bursts, which makes the console extrapolation underreport cost by ~20%.

As a short-term mitigation I'd like:
- A per-slice sampling toggle in the Console UI (ops can force 100% for a slice)
- A diagnostic view that shows raw sampled token counts, extrapolation factors, and the rule that applied

Can infra/data advise on feasibility and a quick rollout plan? I put an example slice definition attached.

Thanks,
Jasmine

Attachments:
- slice-definition-v2.csv (CSV, 12KB)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-05T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [Console] Probe: per-slice sampling toggle + cost attribution

Jasmine — thanks for raising this. Quick clarifying Qs before we scope work: 

1) Is the underreport happening only for burst windows (>95th percentile) or also during steady traffic? The remediation differs.
2) Do we expect this toggle to be an override of the sampling policy (UI flips a flag for telemetry to ignore sampling) or to actually change what the telemetry pipeline emits? If it's an override, infra changes are smaller and we can canary sooner.

I'll draft a minimal Console mock for the toggle and attach a slice->route map to speed infra/data debugging.

- Marissa

Attachments:
- slice-to-route-map.csv (CSV, 2KB)

From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acme.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-06T08:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [Console] Probe: per-slice sampling toggle + cost attribution

Thanks for looking into this. For our logs we see two windows (2027-03-28T14:00 and 2027-03-28T16:30) where usage spiked due to a batch job; billing shows the full token count, but Console per-route tile shows about 75% of expected. Happy to share the raw logs — attaching one sample screenshot.

If it helps, the batch job emits 300 concurrent parallel calls for ~6 minutes, which probably trips your sampling rules.

-Sarah

Attachments:
- screenshot-cost-drift.png (PNG, 48KB)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-04-07T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: [Console] Probe: per-slice sampling toggle + cost attribution

Summary / next steps: 

- Marissa: prototype UI toggle (Console) + flag in telemetry (ETA 1 sprint) — owner: marissa_cole
- Irene/Data: evaluate pipeline change vs override; provide impact assessment and perf risk (ETA 4 business days) — owner: irene_choi
- Infra (Jonas): quick cron to backfill sampled windows for Acme's examples and a short-term 100% sampling override for tenant slices (ETA 3 business days) — owner: jonas_weber
- Jasmine: coordinate with Acme to validate backfilled numbers and close the ticket

I've opened INF-4821 for tracking and added the attachments. If no objections, we'll roll the UI toggle to canary next week.

Marcus
